description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values for four morphosyntactic tags across six model/layer conditions, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “tag,” with categories ordered left to right as case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (values extend slightly above 20 and below 0). For each tag, six adjacent bars appear in the legend order: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with a vertical black error bar. For case, the bars are approximately 6 (mBERT-L₂), about 5–6 (XLM-L₂), about 3 (mBERT-R₂), about 2 (XLM-R₂), about 12 (mBERT-B₂), and about 11 (XLM-B₂), with error bars spanning roughly from near 0 up to around 12 for the light-blue bar and up to around 20+ for the pink/red bars. For gender, the bars are approximately 1.5 (mBERT-L₂), about 0.3 (XLM-L₂), about 2 (mBERT-R₂), about 1 (XLM-R₂), about 4–4.5 (mBERT-B₂), and about 3–3.5 (XLM-B₂), with error bars extending several units above and below each mean (some dipping below 0). For number, the bars are approximately 1.2 (mBERT-L₂), about 0.8 (XLM-L₂), about 1.0 (mBERT-R₂), about 0.6 (XLM-R₂), about 2.8–3.0 (mBERT-B₂), and about 2.3–2.5 (XLM-B₂), again with sizable error bars reaching below 0 and up to roughly 6–7 for the pink/red bars. For tense, all bars are close to zero, roughly 0.4 (mBERT-L₂), about 0.1 (XLM-L₂), about 0.0–0.1 (mBERT-R₂), about 0.0 (XLM-R₂), about 0.5 (mBERT-B₂), and about 0.6 (XLM-B₂), with shorter error bars that still extend slightly below 0. The bars are grouped by tag rather than sorted by magnitude, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color scheme and the presence of error bars.
